name: Prototype of a Spatial Application or Dashboard
seo_title: GIS Application or Spatial Dashboard Prototype | Spatial Intelligence
title: See the value on your own data first
intro: Instead of a long project with uncertain results, we build a limited-scope prototype that answers a single business question. You see it working, your team tries it out, and then you decide whether to scale based on what you have seen.
card: A web application or dashboard running on your real data within weeks, so you can test the value before scaling up.
fit: A dashboard tracking reports and response times by neighborhood.
A web application for viewing land parcels and land uses and looking up regulations.
A dashboard for tracking development projects in space and time.
steps: Together we define the decision question, the indicators, and the users.
We prepare the necessary data and design its model.
We build the application or dashboard and present the first version.
We test it with users and refine it.
We hand over the prototype along with recommendations for scaling.
receive: A working prototype on your data
Recommendations for moving to the full version
